svg.title: Final board of the trace: Red wins on a diagonal through the last disc
svg.desc: A 6 by 7 board, row 0 at the bottom. Red discs at (0,0), (1,1), (2,2) and (3,3) form a diagonal; the last disc dropped was (2,2), in the middle of the line.
svg.text: after move 13: Red drops into column 2 and wins
the line runs through the last disc, which sits in its middle
